system.description: You and a fully informed, willing subject enter a joint meditative trance for at least an hour while you spend twice the subject's permanent Willpower Traits in Blood Traits to permanently and irreversibly separate the subject's soul from her body, which then dies by sunrise. The freed soul enters the astral plane as per Psychic Projection but without a silver cord; reaching zero Willpower there costs a permanent Willpower Trait and a year-and-a-day recovery, while reaching zero permanent Willpower destroys the soul forever. Usable only on mortals (excluding mages) or vampires who have attained Golconda, including the caster.
system.bloodCost: Twice the subject's permanent Willpower Traits in Blood Traits
